utterances.gloss_en: The president arrives, but our prayer is now; that day it was just like that.
utterances.gloss_fr: Le président arrive, mais notre prière se fait maintenant ; ce jour-là, c'était ainsi.

recent_exchanges.topic: Debating the arrival of factory medicines like asetaminofɛni (paracetamol) sold under names Panadɔli/Korosini, how to measure doses in traditional tɔgɔrɛ units, whether foreign cures from Romɛ or Pariseke surpass local bark remedies, and if the stimulating kofe bean disrupts herbal treatments.
recent_exchanges.orchestrator_directive: Elicit Bambara terms for pharmaceutical forms (tablet, syrup), dosage fractions, provenance markers, and interaction warnings; capture ideophones for medicinal taste/effect.

utterances.text_native: Asetaminofɛni bɛ Panadɔli ni Korosini kɔnɔ, nka an ka dɔsiri kɔrɔw bɛ tɔgɔrɛ fɛlɛ fɛlɛ la, kofe fana bɛ se ka nɛnɛyɔrɔw bali.
utterances.gloss_en: Paracetamol is inside Panadol and Korosini, but our old remedies are measured in tɔgɔrɛ spoonfuls; coffee too can block the medicines.
utterances.gloss_fr: Le paracétamol est dans le Panadol et le Korosini, mais nos remèdes anciens se mesurent en tɔgɔrɛ (cuillères) ; le café aussi peut bloquer les médicaments.

utterances.text_native: I ni ce! Jeli bɛ baara kɛ Debating the arrival of factory medicine la.

utterances.text_native: An ka dɔgɔya bɛ tɔgɔrɛ kɔnɔ, nka asetaminofɛni bɛ piluli la; kofe bɛ se ka dɔsi faga wa?
utterances.gloss_en: Our remedies are in spoonfuls, but paracetamol is in pills; can coffee kill the dose?
utterances.gloss_fr: Nos remèdes sont en cuillerées, mais le paracétamol est en pilules; le café peut-il tuer la dose?

utterances.text_native: Banco kɛɲɛni na, an bɛ raya kɛ a kan ka a ɲi.

utterances.gloss_fr: Dans la maçonnerie en banco, on trace des motifs dessus pour l'embellir.

utterances.gloss_fr: Nous faisons aussi du yizilayɛma sur les murs pour les rendre beaux.

recent_exchanges.topic: Jeli and Kɔrɔba discuss the recent visit of Anna and Yoru, foreign envoys from the United States and China, who spoke of armées and TikTok bans, while debating the proper Bambara names for these new geopolitical realities.
recent_exchanges.orchestrator_directive: Elicit native Bambara terms for 'army', 'United States', 'China', 'Chinese language', and 'sovereignty', and document any calques or loanword adaptations used in political discourse.

utterances.text_native: Anna na etats-unis kɔnɔ, nsumaya kuma kɛra, nka an bɛ fɛ ka mogo-mogo-ya dɔn.
utterances.gloss_en: Anna came from the United States and spoke of power, but we want to understand sovereignty.
utterances.gloss_fr: Anna est venue des États-Unis et a parlé de puissance, mais nous voulons comprendre la souveraineté.

recent_exchanges.topic: Debating the precise Bambara terms for Islamic dawn prayer (subahi/sumi) versus traditional rooster-crow reckoning (suno/sunogo), the hereditary title Sigikurunnin 'Dawn-Master' who announces fasting times, and the creeping use of French loans like bonne/digne in scheduling market openings.
recent_exchanges.orchestrator_directive: Elicit native Bambara lexemes for each prayer phase, the Sigikurunnin's ritual formulas, and whether bonne/digne are calqued or code-switched; record tonal patterns and any ideophonic variants.

utterances.text_native: Sigikurunnin bɛ sumi folo ni wulicaw bɛ sunogo kunnakɔli, kɔnɔ jɛkulu bɛ ɲininkali dɔn ko sumi ni sunogo tɔgɔw ye bamanankan kuma ye wa?
utterances.gloss_en: The Dawn-Master announces the dawn prayer when the roosters crow at daybreak, but the elders ask whether the terms for dawn prayer and daybreak are truly Bambara words, no?
utterances.gloss_fr: Le Maître de l'aube annonce la prière de l'aube quand les coqs chantent au point du jour, mais les anciens demandent si les termes de la prière de l'aube et de l'aube sont de vrais mots bambara, n'est-ce pas ?

utterances.text_native: Sumi bɛ suno kɔnɔ, gikurunnin bɛ fɔlɔ, kɔnɔ jɛkulu bɛ ɲininkali ko tɔgɔw ye bamanankan ye.
utterances.gloss_en: Dawn prayer is at rooster crow, the dawn-master announces first, but the elders ask whether the names are truly Bambara.
utterances.gloss_fr: La prière de l'aube est au chant du coq, le maître de l'aube annonce en premier, mais les anciens demandent si les noms sont vraiment bambara.
